test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If (a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc) = 405, and (a - b)² + (b - c)² + (c -a)² = 54, find the value of (a + b + c).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Formula: a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = 1/2 × (a + b + c) × [(a − b)² + (b − c)² + (c − a)²]

Substitute the given values directly:

405 = 1/2 × (a + b + c) × 54

405 = 27 × (a + b + c) ⇒ a + b + c = 15

**∴ The correct answer is 15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = 405

(a − b)² + (b − c)² + (c − a)² = 54

**Formula Used:**

a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = 1/2 × (a + b + c) × [(a − b)² + (b − c)² + (c − a)²]

**Calculation:**

⇒ 405 = 1/2 × (a + b + c) × 54

⇒ 405 = (a + b + c) × 27

⇒ a + b + c = 405 ÷ 27

⇒ a + b + c = 15

**∴ The correct answer is 15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Standard Form of the Identity

a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca)

Conditional Identity

If a + b + c = 0, then a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc.

Important Variation

a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = (a + b + c)[(a + b + c)² − 3(ab + bc + ca)]
